responsibility: Implements the Go frontend’s expression IR and most expression semantics, including traversal, location propagation, type determination, constant handling, export/import support, backend lowering hooks, diagnostics for misuse, and numerous concrete expression forms. It is the main execution point for building, validating, transforming, and serializing expression nodes and for evaluating and constraining numeric constants across Go’s typed and untyped constant rules.
same_name_distinction: Provides the implementation of the expression hierarchy’s behavior: traversal, typing, diagnostics, exporting/importing hooks, backend lowering support, and numeric-constant operations. Unlike expressions.h, this file supplies the semantics and algorithms for expression nodes rather than declaring the class hierarchy and factories.
